# KBK Community Donation Tracking System

> Kapisanan Buklod ng Kabataan (KBK) is a youth-led community organization supporting community giving in Lipa City, Batangas, Philippines. This website shares public donation progress, community needs, activities, and information about how to contact or support KBK.

## Public pages

- [Home](./)
- [About KBK](./about.html)
- [Donation categories and current needs](./categories.html)
- [Community progress and transparency](./transparency.html)
- [Donation impact](./impact.html)
- [Projects and activities](./public-projects.html)
- [Distribution summaries](./public-distributions.html)
- [News and announcements](./updates.html)
- [How to donate](./donate.html)
- [Request assistance](./assistance.html)
- [Contact KBK](./contact.html)
- [Privacy notice](./privacy.html)

## Content guidance

- Public totals and records may change as KBK reviews and updates its data.
- Assistance requests are intended for authorized representatives of Lipa City Local Government Units only. Submission does not guarantee approval.
- Do not infer or disclose private donor, recipient, contact, or administrative information.
- For current information, refer to the public pages above.
